name: Snatch (Kettlebell)
instructions: Swing a kettlebell between your legs, then explosively extend the hips.
Punch your hand through as the bell travels overhead in one motion.
Catch it locked out with a straight arm — don't bang the wrist.
Lower to the swing and repeat. A full-body power developer.
longevityNotes: A strong hinge is back insurance. Learn it light, groove it often, and add load slowly — the goal is a back that never complains about picking things up.
overview: An advanced kettlebell hinge-pattern exercise for the full-body. Snatch (Kettlebell) builds posterior-chain strength that protects your back in everyday lifting.
